departure_hour.description: Hour of scheduled departure extracted from CRSDepTime.

dep_hour_sin.description: Cyclic sine encoding of scheduled departure hour: sin(2*pi*hour/24).

dep_hour_cos.description: Cyclic cosine encoding of scheduled departure hour: cos(2*pi*hour/24).

dep_minute_of_day_sin.description: Cyclic sine encoding of minute-of-day: sin(2*pi*min/1440).

dep_minute_of_day_cos.description: Cyclic cosine encoding of minute-of-day: cos(2*pi*min/1440).

is_weekend.description: Flag indicating if flight is scheduled on Saturday or Sunday.

day_of_week_sin.description: Cyclic sine encoding of day of week: sin(2*pi*dow/7).

day_of_week_cos.description: Cyclic cosine encoding of day of week: cos(2*pi*dow/7).

month_sin.description: Cyclic sine encoding of month: sin(2*pi*month/12).

month_cos.description: Cyclic cosine encoding of month: cos(2*pi*month/12).

distance.description: Flight distance between origin and destination airports.

scheduled_elapsed_time.description: Scheduled planned flight duration from gate to gate.

airline_delay_prior.available_at_prediction: Yes (Historical prior from training set only)
airline_delay_prior.description: Smoothed historical delay rate of the carrier calculated exclusively on earlier training flights.

origin_delay_prior.available_at_prediction: Yes (Historical prior from training set only)
origin_delay_prior.description: Smoothed historical delay rate of the origin airport calculated exclusively on earlier training flights.

destination_delay_prior.available_at_prediction: Yes (Historical prior from training set only)
destination_delay_prior.description: Smoothed historical delay rate of the destination airport calculated exclusively on earlier training flights.

route_delay_prior.available_at_prediction: Yes (Historical prior from training set only)
route_delay_prior.description: Smoothed historical delay rate of the route calculated exclusively on earlier training flights.

airline.description: Operating airline code (e.g. AA, DL, UA, WN). One-hot encoded.

origin.description: Origin airport IATA code (e.g. ORD, ATL, DFW). One-hot encoded.

destination.description: Destination airport IATA code (e.g. LAX, JFK, SFO). One-hot encoded.

route.description: Route origin_dest string (e.g. ORD_LAX). High cardinality.

is_delayed_15.description: Supervised learning target: 1 if flight arrival delay >= 15 min, 0 otherwise.
